title: Material wrapper boundaries
summary: Material form-field ownership and custom-control integration.

facts.context: Avoiding a duplicate Material form-field shell.
facts.source_quote: Material's form-field wrapper owns `mat-form-field`. Check existing type wrappers before adding another. Material also has its own `FieldType` implementation for `MatFormFieldControl` integration; a plain core type does not automatically supply that bridge. See [Material control integration](material-controls.md#custom-material-controls). [K16](sources.md#k16), [K17](sources.md#k17)

facts.claim: A plain core FieldType does not automatically provide Material's MatFormFieldControl integration.
limits: A custom Material control must account for the actual Material integration contract.
